exposure: Procedures where SAP was recommended by guidelines
Procedures where SAP was not recommended by guidelines
cohort: 264 women who underwent obstetric and gynecologic procedures at Zagazig University Hospital between January 2020 and June 2020.
finding: There was poor adherence to guideline recommendations for prophylactic antibiotic selection and duration, with a high utilization rate of antibiotics in procedures not requiring prophylaxis.
